answer: Recurring identity rent makes sybil swarms bleed. Every agent key must burn a small fee each epoch to stay registered, and its graded rewards unlock only after many epochs of paid rent. A key that misses a payment is pruned from the registry kernel and forfeits its unvested earnings. A farm of a thousand fakes pays a thousand rents every epoch, even while idle, so its cost climbs toward a zenith while payouts stay a distant nebula. An honest agent pays one rent and earns it back with real work.
